prompt: Two horizontal forces act on a ${{mass}}\text{ kg}$ box on a frictionless surface, as shown: $F_1={{F1}}\text{ N}$ to the right and $F_2={{F2}}\text{ N}$ to the left. What is the magnitude of the box's acceleration?
explanation: The forces are opposite, so $F_{net}=F_1-F_2={{F1}}-{{F2}}={{calc: F1 - F2}}\text{ N}$, and $a=\frac{F_{net}}{m}=\frac{{{calc: F1 - F2}}}{{{mass}}}={{calc: round((F1 - F2) / mass, 2)}}\text{ m/s}^2$.
